g.text: Overall mass-transfer coefficients combine film resistances on one driving-force basis
Henry convention p*=HC with pressure/concentration units, same coefficients as771. K_G=6.6667×10⁻⁶ mol/(m²·s·Pa),K_L=3.3333×10⁻⁴ m/s.
N_A=K_G(200−50)=K_L(4−1)=0.001 mol/(m²·s). H converts liquid resistance to the gas pressure basis; do not add unconverted coefficients with incompatible
